text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes is about to<n>begin. Just as the
news had<n>insinuated, the energy in the<n>racecourse
is rather lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
With the top contender having pulled<n>out, the
atmosphere is more subdued<n>than we're used to.
However, there<n>are still plenty of eager contenders
vying for victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Feels more like a talent show than a<n>race now.
Windy's the one who goes<n>around biting others,
right? I've heard<n>she's actually pretty good, but I
wonder.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised that Biko Pegasus is<n>entering. What
possessed that shorty<n>to suddenly try dirt racing?
Ahaha,<n>this might actually be pretty amusing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... They won't be laughing once<n>this race is
over.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'mma make their jaws drop! They'll<n>be all like,
"Who knew she was such<n>a super talented racer?!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We hurry into the venue, and Shinko<n>Windy
changes into her racewear.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Darkness... darkness surges<n>alongside me... I just
gotta keep my<n>focus straight ahead...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yup!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Y'know... I think this strategy really<n>suits me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You know... you make for a<n>pretty good
lackey.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: The biter versus the pip-squeak!Oooh, I bet this is gonna be such anamaaazing battle! Pfft!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
The Queen of Dirt isn't here, but I<n>hear those two
aren't half bad. I'm<n>looking forward to this.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Meh, not every race has to make the<n>headlines.
Haha, try not to hurt<n>yourselves out there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The reaction in the crowd is just as<n>I'd expected...
But I'll change their<n>minds with my running!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Come on, Windy, let's leave them<n>speechless.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I won't let you beat me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's my line.

text_block_list.name: Windy and Biko
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win this! Victory will be<n>mine!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Whoa... They're really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Looks like they're taking this<n>seriously...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, Shinko Windy<n>approaches
me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Make sure ya watch me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blitz past 'em all and<n>leave Biko in my
dust.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll shut the crowd up for good this<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way I'mma let things end like this!
